title: Bindings registry index
description: PROPOSED (ADR-042, not yet accepted). The index a bindings registry publishes (default: the gtme-bindings repository's index.json; GTME_REGISTRY overrides). `gtme adapters search` reads it; `gtme adapters add` installs an entry by its source ref. Verified entries are maintained in the registry repository and fixture-tested by its CI; community entries point at their authors' repositories and ship fixtures, which `adapters add` runs before installing.

path.description: Directory inside the repository holding binding.yaml and fixtures/.

ref.description: Tag or branch the entry was published at.

sha.description: Commit the ref resolved to when the index was generated.

sha256.description: Content hash of the binding directory; `adapters add` refuses a mismatch.
